playoff.entries: 13th and 14th vs 4th and 3rd of the Division of Honour
playoff.note: Two single-match ties; each winner plays in the National Division next season.

playoff.entries: 3rd and 4th vs 14th and 13th of the National Division
playoff.note: Same two ties from the other side. 13th/14th also face the two 1. Division series runners-up for their own survival.

boundaries.note: National Division: 15th and 16th down direct, 13th and 14th in two one-off ties. Division of Honour: top two up direct, 3rd and 4th in those ties. Four places, two of them contested; if both top-flight clubs win, only two clubs change level.

notes: Names: level 1 is the National Division, sponsored as BGL Ligue; level 2 is the Division of Honour (Luxembourgish Eierepromotioun, German Ehrenpromotion) - our name is the German form, which is what the local press uses. Level 3 is the 1. Division, split into two series, not modelled; the Division of Honour's bottom two go down there and 13th/14th play the two series runners-up. All sizes 16 both levels, 30 rounds each, confirmed for 2025-26 and unchanged for 2026-27.
